answer: Practically, the chain should attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because bridge only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, beacon is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any fable approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
